name: Per-call difficulty tiering
goal: Every harness LLM call runs at the model class its difficulty needs: Haiku-level calls keep the local-box -> Haiku-class chain; Sonnet-level calls (Stop-hook continuation judge H2, Commander worker health C11) skip the local box and use the Sonnet class; fail-closed gates step up one class (C5/C6 escalation and C8/C9/C10 backup -> Sonnet class) instead of Opus; C7 approve_plan and C12 kill_worker stay on the Opus class; Opus-class workers get an Opus-class advisor (T8); the Advisor Fallback directive follows the same class rule on every surface (T10); the stale default-label test is fixed (T7) so the commit is fully green for deploy right after this loop (T9).
model_classes: Every tier is a class resolved per client. haiku: Claude Haiku | hooks Codex newest installed gpt-*-luna else gpt-6-luna | Commander Codex providers.clients.codex.models.haiku (default gpt-5.6-luna). sonnet: Claude Sonnet | hooks Codex newest installed gpt-*-terra else gpt-5.6-terra | Commander Codex models.sonnet (default gpt-5.6-terra). opus: Claude Opus | not used by hooks | Commander Codex models.opus (default gpt-5.6-sol). Operator 2026-10-16: "Please note that "opus" is an opus class model, which includes sol if we are running codex".
